name: Social Security beneficiaries by state (SSA): retirement, survivors and disability, counts and monthly amounts, December 2025
description: The Social Security Administration's counts and monthly benefit amounts of OASDI beneficiaries by state, DC and five territories, by type of benefit: retired workers and their spouses and children, survivors, and disabled workers and their spouses and children, with the number aged 65 or older by sex. Average benefits are computed from SSA's own counts and amounts.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Social Security beneficiaries by state (SSA): retirement, survivors and disability, counts and monthly amounts, December 2025 (Version 1.0.1) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24022958
keywords: social security disability recipients by state
average social security benefit by state

distribution.name: ssa-beneficiaries.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: ssa-beneficiaries.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).
